title: Vehicle Following Window Summary Similar
goal: Read a drive telemetry CSV with ego speed, lead speed, and gap columns containing missing lead-vehicle samples; segment contiguous open-road, following, and critical-gap windows; and write a summary CSV with start/end times, sample counts, average ego speed, minimum gap, and valid TTC statistics for each window.
skillBenefitRationale: This stays close to the source domain while shifting from controller implementation to the core csv-processing workflow: ingesting time-series CSV data, handling null lead-vehicle rows, deriving columns, grouping contiguous windows, and exporting a structured summary CSV.
